lane_declaration: Geometry-only research lane. Targets blind normal-fault damage zones clustering off the mapped USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue trace at the 300 m DTI kernel scale: zero on the mapped trace, peaked collar around visible faults at 100-400 m, decay to zero by ~1.2 km, computed per holdout fold from visible faults only, visible faults masked pixel-exactly from scoring, 2.8 px dot separation, 37,654-dot budget. Zero SGMC, zero lidar, zero external data, no model training. Uses the shared template's pinned gems57 evaluator (gems57-pooled-hide-v2, alpha=0.2, beta=0.8, 300 m triangular kernel) and the shared fail-closed submission_writer.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Hanging-wall fault-damage collar at kernel scale (implemented in Exp 1)
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: Off-trace damage-zone clustering at ~1 kernel radius (300 m) from visible faults; on-trace trough so mapped faults earn no credit.
ranked_hypotheses.why_unmapped_not_catalogued: Blind/low-relief splays parallel to mapped traces under Quaternary cover never entered the Quaternary fault catalogue.
ranked_hypotheses.named_non_fault_mimic: Lake Lahontan/Bonneville terrace risers, symmetric washes, road and canal cuts.
ranked_hypotheses.difference_vs_repo: D77 used a flat 250 m-1 km distance band (0.0000 HOLDOUT-DTI); H83 uses a kernel-scale peaked collar with per-fold visible-faults-only features and buffered whole-component hide-and-recover.
ranked_hypotheses.expected_dti_gain_qualitative: Uncertain, low-medium; may be ~0 if withheld truth does not sit near visible traces.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Catalogue fault-intersection / relay-node intensity
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: Kernel density of fault intersections and relay bends (damage focusing).
ranked_hypotheses.why_unmapped_not_catalogued: The node is real even when a small blind splay terminating at it is unmapped.
ranked_hypotheses.named_non_fault_mimic: Mapped intersections of inactive traces; drainage junctions.
ranked_hypotheses.difference_vs_repo: No repo lane uses node/intersection intensity as primary scorer.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Signed across-strike K/Th radiometric asymmetry
layers: GeoDAWN K/Th (USGS DOI 10.5066/P93LGLVQ; registry/data_manifest.json ext_geodawn_*, not locally restored)
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: First derivative of K/Th normal to local catalogue strike, signed by hanging-wall side.
ranked_hypotheses.why_unmapped_not_catalogued: Alteration halo outcrops where the trace is buried below mapping scale.
ranked_hypotheses.difference_vs_repo: No repo lane uses signed across-strike radiometric asymmetry as primary.
ranked_hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium; needs restored external bands; not obtainable from this sandbox's outbound allowlist (github.com only) — deferred

ranked_hypotheses.title: Multi-scale residual curvature after regional trend removal
layers: pinned 54-channel feature stack det_elev + curvature bands (data/processed/stack.npy, not locally restored)
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: Curvature of detrended piedmont surface at 300 m-1.2 km scales.
ranked_hypotheses.why_unmapped_not_catalogued: Sub-mapping-scale scarps survive in curvature texture.
ranked_hypotheses.difference_vs_repo: Selective-U used raw U-rank curvature without detrending or scale sweep.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Thermal spring/well alignment anisotropy (GDR 1391)
layers: DOE/NREL GDR submission 1391 well/spring temperatures (DOI 10.15121/1881483, CC BY 4.0)
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: Linear alignment of warm springs/wells (Hough / kernel-density anisotropy).
ranked_hypotheses.why_unmapped_not_catalogued: Thermal memory survives where geomorphic expression is buried.
ranked_hypotheses.named_non_fault_mimic: Evaporative brine anomalies; irrigation return flow.
ranked_hypotheses.difference_vs_repo: H78 used distance-to-manifestation proximity only; this adds alignment anisotropy.
ranked_hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low-Medium; gdr.openei.org not reachable from this sandbox — deferred

promotion_rule: format valid: submission_writer fail-closed checks PASS (single-band float32, EPSG:32611, 3730x3292, transform (100,0,243350,0,-100,4508550), values in [0,1], no NaN, zeros outside footprint, 0 dots on catalogue)
canary: every feature alone AUC <=0.90 on holdout (else flag leakage, verdict negative)
HOLDOUT-DTI: pooled hide-and-recover, evaluator gems57-pooled-hide-v2, withheld positives + paired 95% CI; report vs random control; never project to leaderboard
registry: compare_array_to_registry vs locally accessible indexed rasters; incomplete scan is a scope limitation, never a clearance; literal dense-witness gate (I17) reported FAIL-closed
verdict_if_any_fails: negative (deliverable). File OK to download, NOT OK to submit automatically. Selector decides any weekly slot.
budget_and_protocol.external_data_needed: None for Exp 1; SHA-pinned bridge grid only.
